description: This file defines two BroadcastReceiver classes, AlarmReceiver and BootReceiver, for handling alarm triggers and system boot events in an Android application. AlarmReceiver enqueues a work request to LockWorker based on received intents, while BootReceiver is set up for handling device reboot logic.

classes.name: AlarmReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that triggers LockWorker when an alarm intent is received.

classes.name: BootReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver intended to handle device reboot events to reschedule alarms.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast intents, enqueues LockWorker with relevant data for AlarmReceiver, minimal implementation for BootReceiver.
